Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The time noun already identifies an era, so adding a second “time of” expression is redundant. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看：一看到，Use the resultative complement to show that he actually sees the people before wanting to help them. [rule: resultative_complement]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，Use this word for people in general when there is no previously named person or group being contrasted. [teacher rule: bieren]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，Use the classifier 株 for one individual plant. [rule: none]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 有植物的地方：有这种植物的地方，Use 这种植物 to refer clearly back to the particular plant introduced in the previous sentence. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他看到：看到，After 神农 has already been named in the same sentence and no other character competes as the subject, use zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 神农三个月走去：神农走了三个月，Put the duration after the action, and use 了 to mark the completed three-month journey; 去 is not needed here without a destination. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
一看 means looking, whereas 一看到 correctly expresses seeing the people before wanting to help them.
别的人 is wrong here, but replacing it with 别人 does not supply the intended 病人 and retains the unsuitable meaning.
一株植物 is a good choice, but 一个植物 is understandable and not an error the teacher marked.
有植物的地方 is grammatical and sufficiently understandable in context, while 有这种植物的地方 is only more explicit.
他 after the preceding action clauses still clearly refers to 神农, so its deletion is optional rather than required.
The duration must follow 走, and 了 correctly marks the completed three-month journey.
